root_cause.text: Missing kfree() calls for dynamically allocated rctx->adata buffer in error paths of starfive_aes_aead_do_one_req(), causing memory leaks when sg_copy_to_buffer() or starfive_aes_hw_init() fail.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds kfree(rctx->adata) in two error paths: (1) after sg_copy_to_buffer() fails to copy the expected number of bytes, and (2) after starfive_aes_hw_init() returns an error. The CVE description explicitly states "allocates rctx->adata with kzalloc() but fails to free it if sg_copy_to_buffer() or starfive_aes_hw_init() fails," and the patch ensures cleanup by adding kfree() calls in these previously unhandled error paths before returning error codes.
